items.title: Show HN: ADB dock a macOS menu bar app to wirelessly connect Android devices
items.contentSnippet:
ADB Dock is a macOS menu bar app for seeing which Android devices are connected, pairing new devices with a code, and keeping your approved devices attached over adb.
With agents being the primary UI to interact with code opening Android Studio is not required anymore. This menu bar helps me quickly connect and disconnect devices.
Looking forward to others trying it out and open for feedback.

items.title: Show HN: OpenPetCam – a self-hosted pet camera that goes looking for your dog
items.contentSnippet:
I wanted a camera for our dog that didn't stream my living room through a vendor's cloud, and that could answer "where is she?" without me steering a joystick. OpenPetCam is what came out of that.
The camera is a cheap pan/tilt model reflashed with Thingino (open firmware). It dials out over WireGuard to a $5 VPS, so nothing is open on the home network. The server relays WebRTC to your phone, records a rolling 6 hours, and runs the detection.

items.contentSnippet:
